author: Akien
prose:
those should get sorted too. and we need to make sure all the devices can consume all their messages and that they're not pointed in the wrong place and so on. we should ticket everything, but you also just did several things even to get this far. how do you think we should be tracking during these fixes? it's kind of an unusual catchup-just-to-make-it-all-go kind of effort

[and, after CC proposed: grow orient's device_census with a mail-reachability column as the derived site plan; one intention with children rather than N intentions; undeliverable mail raises a counted trouble]

i agree with your proposals on all fronts. and if we wind up with a lot of trouble tickets from all the things not working right, i'm ok with that, because that's our to do list. in fact, if you just wanted to go put trouble emissions in all the places needing work until they were resolved, some sense in that. no lists to maintain, it's self maintaining.
